campaigns.title: Unauthorized file copy to removable media - laptop-301
campaigns.summary: Identity nora.contractor copied a payroll file to a USB device on host laptop-301, a host with zero authentication history anywhere in the archive.
rejected_hypotheses: nora.contractor used her own laptop after logging in elsewhere at files-01 - rejected: no auth record of any kind exists for laptop-301, in any schema version, top-level or nested; 66-minute gap and different host makes session continuity implausible.
campaigns.next_collection_action: Pull asset-assignment records to confirm intended owner of laptop-301; check whether its endpoint agent has an auth-telemetry gap.

campaigns.title: Unattributed large outbound transfer via shared gateway 10.41.50.22
campaigns.summary: 884,944-byte outbound connection to the only external IP ever seen from this gateway, with no single user session spanning the event.
rejected_hypotheses: Transfer tied to user075's 03:13:42 login - rejected: 8-hour gap, no session continuity, and closest endpoint activity (11:37:37) belongs to a different identity (user228) on the same shared host.
campaigns.next_collection_action: Pull gateway/proxy-level logs directly, since host-level identity attribution does not resolve on current data.

campaigns.title: Password spray against vpn-01 followed by encoded PowerShell execution (spray-v1)
campaigns.summary: 12-day low-and-slow password spray from external IP 198.51.100.124 against vpn-01, succeeding on day 13 against amina-ad4 with MFA push_approved, followed 66 minutes later by obfuscated PowerShell execution under the same identity's alias on wkstn-624.
rejected_hypotheses: Legitimate employee mistyping password 12 times over 12 days - rejected: uniform daily 02:15:00 UTC cadence, single shared source IP, and sequential different usernames each day is inconsistent with one person's own login mistakes.
campaigns.next_collection_action: Pull MFA provider logs to determine whether push_approved was a genuine user action; review wkstn-624 for post-execution artifacts.
